summaries.en: Chronos-T5-tiny is a compact time series forecasting model that enables accurate predictions without extensive historical data or domain expertise. It adapts the T5 text-to-text architecture to treat time series as token sequences, allowing it to learn universal patterns across diverse datasets. Users can fine-tune it on their own data with minimal preprocessing, making it ideal for prototyping forecasting applications in finance, energy, or IoT systems where traditional models require complex feature engineering.
summaries.zh: Chronos-T5-tiny 是一个轻量级时间序列预测模型，它解决了传统方法需要大量历史数据和专业领域知识的问题。该模型巧妙地将T5文本生成架构应用于时间序列，通过将数值序列转换为标记序列来学习跨领域的通用模式。这种设计让用户只需少量数据即可进行微调，特别适合金融趋势分析、能源消耗预测或物联网设备监控等场景的快速实验和部署，为开发者提供了高效且灵活的预测工具。

summaries.en: Multilingual-E5-base is a versatile text embedding model that converts sentences in over 100 languages into comparable numerical vectors, enabling cross-lingual semantic search and similarity tasks. Its key innovation lies in using contrastive learning with multilingual text pairs, allowing it to capture semantic meaning across languages without direct translation. Developers can implement it via the sentence-transformers library for applications like multilingual document retrieval, content recommendation across languages, or building multilingual chatbots that understand user intent regardless of language.
summaries.zh: Multilingual-E5-base 是一个支持超过100种语言的多语言文本嵌入模型，可将句子转换为数值向量，实现跨语言语义搜索与相似性匹配。其采用对比学习方法直接学习语言间的语义对应关系，无需翻译步骤。该模型可通过sentence-transformers库集成，应用于多语言文档检索、跨语言内容推荐及多语言智能对话系统，为全球化应用提供语义理解支持。
